name: MMATH
description: MMATH is a multilingual benchmark for complex mathematical reasoning, containing 374 high-quality math problems across 10 typologically diverse languages. It evaluates multilingual reasoning capabilities of large language models and explores strategies to improve performance and language consistency.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is gaining attention in multilingual math reasoning research but is not yet widely established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Addresses multilingual complex reasoning with math problems; highlights performance disparities and off-target language generation issues.
